Brad Pitt Returns as Cliff Booth in The Further Mis-Adventures with New Retro Poster and IMAX Details

Key takeawaysNetflix has released a new retro-styled promotional poster and a 60-second video for *The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth*, featuring Brad Pitt reprising his role from *Once Upon a Time… in Hollywood*. Reports indicate that the upcoming feature is scheduled for an

Netflix has released a new retro-styled promotional poster and a 60-second video for *The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth*, featuring Brad Pitt reprising his role from *Once Upon a Time… in Hollywood*. Reports indicate that the upcoming feature is scheduled for an IMAX theatrical release before arriving on the streaming platform.

Release Schedule and Viewing Options

  • IMAX Theatrical Release: November 25, 2026, with tickets currently reported to be on sale.
  • Streaming Debut: December 23, 2026, on Netflix.

Plot and Setting

Set in 1977—eight years after the events of the previous film—the narrative follows Cliff Booth as a Hollywood fixer in a shifting entertainment industry. The story explores his work handling behind-the-scenes scandals and navigating trouble across Los Angeles.

Production and Cast

  • Director: David Fincher
  • Writer: Quentin Tarantino (screenplay)
  • Producers: Brad Pitt and Ceán Chaffin
  • Music: Trent Reznor and Atticus Ross
  • Cast Members: Elizabeth Debicki, Scott Caan, Carla Gugino, Yahya Abdul-Mateen II, Peter Weller, Matt Groove, JB Tadena, Corey Fogelmanis, and Karren Karagulian.

Leonardo DiCaprio is not expected to appear in the project as Rick Dalton. Viewers interested in verifying screening availability or ticket purchases can check official IMAX channels and Netflix announcements.
